name: Cannalicious Crumble | Pink Cookies
description: Crumble is a cannabis concentrate extracted from cured plant material. While wax and crumble will have similar potencies, compared to the smooth, honey like texture of wax, Crumble has a dry and more brittle appearance. This makes it easier to handle and a bit more versatile for consumption.
